offence_note: Multiple frauds, fraudulent GST refunds via sham companies
sentence_quote: Mr. Bath, on each of the six charges of which I found you guilty, I sentence you to imprisonment for four and one-half years.
note: Four and one-half years recorded as 54 months; concurrent on each count.

offence_note: Loaded firearm possession, firearm while prohibited, mischief
sentence_quote: sentence is varied to 4 years and 9 months. He is, of course, entitled to credit for 367 days pre-sentence custody on a 1:1 basis
note: Crown appeal allowed; trial sentence was 2 years less 2 days plus 367 days credit.

offence_note: Theft under $5,000 using stolen bank card
sentence_quote: The sentence is reduced from six months to three months to be served concurrently with the Nanaimo Offences.
note: Concurrent with 12-month sentence already being served.

offence_note: Group assault by court officers on a prisoner
co_offenders: Findlay: 60 days added custody; Kang: 30 days added custody; Martin: 45 days added custody
sentence_quote: we impose the following additional terms to be served in custody: The respondent Feeney 60 days; the respondent Findlay 60 days; the respondent Kang 30 days; and the respondent Martin 45 days.
note: Conditional sentences of 45-90 days (mostly served) kept, plus added custody.

offence_note: Possession of fentanyl and cocaine for trafficking
sentence_quote: a sentence of eight years is imposed for the fentanyl conviction, and five years for the cocaine conviction, the sentences (together with the sentence for the breach of probation) to be served concurrently
note: Crown appeal; 5 years on cocaine concurrent; Impact of Race and Culture Assessment given little effect.

offence_note: Aggravated sexual assaults, robberies, confinement, choking; dangerous offender
sentence_quote: I find that Mr. Jamieson is a dangerous offender and I impose a sentence of detention in the penitentiary for an indeterminate period.
note: Gladue noted but mitigating effect tempered by violence of acts; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Sexual assault of a teenaged complainant
sentence_quote: A two-year custodial sentence followed by two years probation is fit and appropriate in the circumstances.
note: Joint recommendation accepted; SOIRA 20 years, firearms prohibition 10 years.

offence_note: Break and enters, fraud and other offences waived in from Alberta
sentence_quote: I conclude that the sentence is not unfit or 'unfair' and that the sentencing judge did not err in imposing the sentence he did.
note: Four-year global sentence; FAS assessment inconclusive.

offence_note: Imitation firearm used in forcible entry
sentence_quote: I would impose consecutive sentences of 12 months in prison for use of an imitation firearm and ten months in prison for forcible entry, for a global sentence of 22 months' imprisonment (less credit for time served)
systemic_quote: while recognizing the importance of rehabilitation, in a context that includes significant Gladue factors.
note: Probation condition allows live-in treatment if directed by probation officer.
